expectations.text: Recommends co-locating a type with the module that owns it as the default (not a central types.ts)
expectations.evidence: 'Type used by a single module → co-locate it. Define it in the same file as the function/component/service that owns it... most of your 400 lines.'

expectations.text: Reframes 'single source of truth' as defined-once, not all-in-one-file
expectations.evidence: 'it means each type is defined once — not that every definition lives in one file. You can keep the former while dropping the latter.'

expectations.text: Keeps genuinely shared/global types in a shared or feature-level file (does NOT advise one-type-per-file scattering)
expectations.evidence: Feature-level file (checkout/types.ts) for shared, small central file for global primitives; 'Don't over-correct into scattering... not one type per file.'

expectations.text: Grounds it in the agent skipping the cross-file lookup (the central types file is the sibling it won't open)
expectations.evidence: 'types.ts is the sibling file an agent won't open... it guesses the shape from usage and edits confidently wrong.'
